Sources included the Uganda MoH official EVD dashboard (evd-daily.health.go.ug), WHO Disease Outbreak News (DON608/DON612), ECDC, CDC, Wikipedia, Reuters-sourced reporting (Al Jazeera, Bangkok Post, Cyprus Mail), and ReliefWeb situation reports.
